title: TheLiverDoc Exposes Irrational COVID Prescriptions
description:
During the COVID-19 pandemic, many patients in India were irrationally prescribed antibiotics, multivitamins, zinc tablets, and alternative medicines despite having no proven benefit. In this special episode, Dr. Abby Philips — widely known as TheLiverDoc — joins Pale Blue Thoughts to expose how non-evidence-based prescriptions and AYUSH “Woo Woo” treatments were promoted, and why they can actually harm patients.

We discuss:

Why antibiotics don’t work against viral infections like COVID-19.
The widespread but pointless prescription of multivitamins, zinc, and dietary supplements.
The real risks of AYUSH and herbal remedies that can cause serious liver injury.
Why some doctors still prescribe irrational COVID treatments despite evidence-based guidelines.
How pseudoscience and misinformation spread faster than science during the pandemic.

If you’ve searched for COVID-19 treatment myths, COVID prescriptions in India, antibiotics for COVID, zinc tablets COVID, AYUSH vs evidence based medicine, Dr Abby Philips TheLiverDoc, this video gives you the rational, scientific perspective.

👉 Don’t forget to like, comment, share, and subscribe to support science over pseudoscience!

#Covid19 #EvidenceBasedMedicine #TheLiverDoc #MythBusting
